description: FULL-TEXT search inside the actual scanned/printed content of ~40M books via Google Books — find an exact phrase, name, or passage buried inside a book's text, not just its metadata. Use for "search full text for the exact phrase X", "which book mentions Y", historical-record and genealogy lookups (a name + place + date appearing in an old book), or quote verification. Also does plain book/metadata lookup — "find books about X", "books by author Y", verifying ISBNs, finding publishers, getting cover images — pulling structured metadata an LLM would otherwise have to hallucinate. Returns title, authors, publisher, publish date, description, ISBN, page count, cover thumbnails, language, and (when matched) the snippet of book text containing the search terms. Use search_field scoping: intitle:, inauthor:, inpublisher:, subject:, isbn:, lccn:, oclc:.

search_field.description: intitle | inauthor | inpublisher | subject | isbn | lccn | oclc — applied as a prefix to query

name: search
